tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: The quantum and reason for penal charges shall be clearly disclosed by the bank to the customers upfront in the loan agreement and KFS, in addition to being displayed on the bank’s website under ‘Interest rates and Service Charges’.

tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.quote: Providing a reference to the schedule of penal charges displayed on the website of the bank in the sanction letter and loan agreement shall not suffice.
